title: The Optimistic farmer before the rains
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：optimistic　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 optimistic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the builder wrote of ① an optimistic farmer before the rains in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more optimistic than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the optimistic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most optimistic farmer before the rains anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1945 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too optimistic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the optimistic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an optimistic forecast for the harvest, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as optimistic as the forecast for the harvest they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was optimistic or not, and he said so.

By 1958 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something optimistic, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite optimistic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the optimistic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1961, in silence, she wrote of another optimistic farmer before the rains in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more optimistic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most optimistic forecast for the harvest in the whole site, she said in 1963, was the one she could never quite name; the optimistic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 乐观（前置定语 an optimistic farmer before the rains：1951 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件乐观的农夫）
B. adj. 乐观／乐观主义（比较级 more optimistic than：文中两处，一处比雨季前乐观的农夫，一处比预想）
C. adj. 乐观／乐观主义（最高级 the most optimistic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 乐观（表语 too optimistic to do：母亲觉得它太乐观，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 乐观主义（前置定语 an optimistic forecast for the harvest：叔叔把整件事称作一桩乐观主义的乐观预计）
F. adj. 乐观主义（同级比较 as optimistic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对收成的乐观预计相比）
G. adj. 乐观主义（后置定语 something optimistic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 乐观主义（受程度副词修饰 quite optimistic：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: an optimistic farmer before the rains
the most optimistic farmer before the rains anybody
an optimistic forecast for the harvest
The most optimistic forecast for the harvest in

answers.why: optimistic 意为“乐观”，1951 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件乐观的农夫”，此处作前置定语 an optimistic farmer before the rains。
optimistic 意为“乐观”，此处用比较级 more optimistic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
optimistic 意为“乐观”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最乐观的一件，故用最高级 the most optimistic farmer before the rains。
optimistic 意为“乐观”，母亲认为这件东西“太乐观了，谁也用不上”，too optimistic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
optimistic 意为“乐观主义”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩乐观主义的乐观预计”，此处作前置定语 an optimistic forecast for the harvest。
optimistic 意为“乐观主义”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对收成的乐观预计一样乐观主义”，同级比较用 as optimistic as。
optimistic 意为“乐观主义”，施工图上那半行字要的是“乐观主义的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something optimistic。
optimistic 意为“乐观主义”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当乐观主义”，quite 修饰原级 optimistic。
optimistic 意为“乐观主义”，1961 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要乐观主义”，故用比较级 more optimistic than。
optimistic 意为“乐观主义”，母亲 1963 年说的是“整个工地里最乐观主义的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most optimistic forecast for the harvest。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件乐观的农夫。（an optimistic farmer before the rains）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更乐观。（more optimistic than …）
母亲觉得它太乐观，谁也用不上。（too optimistic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩乐观主义的乐观预计。（an optimistic forecast for the harvest）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对收成的乐观预计一样乐观主义。（as optimistic as …）
到了 1958 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件乐观主义的东西。（something optimistic）
answers: In 1951 the builder wrote of an optimistic farmer before the rains in the plan.
Everybody said it was more optimistic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too optimistic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an optimistic forecast for the harvest.
He said nobody would call it as optimistic as the forecast for the harvest they had once had.
By 1958 the plan asked for nothing but something optimistic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 optimistic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the builder wrote of an optimistic farmer before the rains in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most optimistic farmer before the rains in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too optimistic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an optimistic forecast for the harvest, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite optimistic, and everybody laughed.
The optimistic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
